description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 12.02.2024 to 18.02.2024
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and concerns the determination of exchange rates for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and compliance requirements for customs operations, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
